data.long_meaning: The Arabic name Douha is derived from the root 'd-h-w', which means 'to give' or 'gift'. In Islamic tradition, this name is a reminder of Allah's blessings and gifts bestowed upon us. It is also believed to symbolize the spiritual gift of faith and righteousness. The name Douha carries the meaning “Gift, Blessing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Douha usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Douha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Blessing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Douha total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
